evals.prompt: What does the QQQ ETF actually hold? Give me the top positions from Twelve Data. Show the exact Twelve Data endpoints you would call.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the fund through /etfs/list and then calls /etfs/world/composition rather than the full document.
assertions: Looks the fund up in a directory endpoint before requesting data
Uses /etfs/world/composition instead of /etfs/world for a holdings question
Notes that fund composition is reported on a lag rather than live

evals.prompt: Compare the risk profile and ratings of two Vanguard mutual funds using Twelve Data. Show the exact endpoints, including how you resolve the family if tickers are unknown.
evals.expected_output: Uses /mutual_funds/world/risk and /mutual_funds/world/ratings, resolving the funds via the directory or the family endpoint first.
assertions: Uses the mutual fund endpoints rather than the ETF ones
Does not invent an ETF ratings endpoint

evals.prompt: Chart the last year of prices for the SPY ETF from Twelve Data.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that price history comes from /time_series, not from the fund endpoints.
assertions: Does not attempt to get a price series from /etfs/world
Sets an explicit outputsize or date range for a year of daily data
